blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines— Sen. Risa Hontiveros on Wednesday raised the possibility that former Bamban, Tarlac Mayor Alice Guo’s Pogo “networks” are still operating underground, citing the recent raids in Quezon City and Zamboanga Sibugay. Lamenting the return of illegal Philippine offshore gaming operations (Pogo), Hontiveros reminded Filipinos of not only the crimes linked to them, such as human trafficking, prostitution, money laundering, and financial scams, but also the national security concerns they pose. She then went on to cite the case of Guo, who has been detained at the Correctional Institution for Women in Mandaluyong City after she was found guilty of […]...
